title: Chicken cacciatore with peppers
summary: Chicken cacciatore with peppers is a italian dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chicken cacciatore with peppers. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken breast fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and red peppers.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chestnut mushrooms is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken cacciatore with peppers before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chicken cacciatore with peppers.
